title: Haman's plan to exterminate the Jews
description: Haman is elevated above all the princes, but becomes furious because Mordecai refuses to bow down to him. He persuades King Ahasuerus to issue a decree to exterminate all the Jews in the empire, and the day is set by casting lots (pur).

versions.title: Haman's plan to exterminate the Jews
versions.description: Haman, the king's highest official, becomes enraged because Mordecai refuses to bow before him, and persuades King Ahasuerus to issue a decree to destroy all the Jews throughout the kingdom.
versions.reason: [minor] references: Chapter 3 is a distinct unit concerning Haman's plan and the decree. The reference is accurate and appropriate. There is real overlap with 'Esther saves her people' (3:1-7:10), but this entry focuses specifically on Haman's plan.; [minor] description: Haman is described as 'the king's highest official' - the text states he was elevated above all the princes, which is sufficiently precise.
